tenders.title: Provision of Remote Diagnostic and Predictive Maintenance System (RDPMS) at 54 Stations in Southern Railway
tenders.scope_summary: The tender is for the provision of a Remote Diagnostic and Predictive Maintenance System (RDPMS) at 54 railway stations across Southern Railway (MAS-11, SA-22, PGT-21 stations). The system will enable remote diagnostics and predictive maintenance capabilities for railway assets.
key_points: System for remote diagnostics and predictive maintenance.

tenders.title: Supply and Installation of Digital Twin of Thermal Management System for Electric Vehicle
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for the supply and installation of a Digital Twin of a Thermal Management System for an Electric Vehicle. The system will include specific hardware and software components as detailed in the annexure.
key_points: Supply and installation of Digital Twin for EV Thermal Management.
Local supplier preference (Class-I / Class-II) with minimum 20% local content.

tenders.title: BIM Services for Demolition of Standard Design Factory 1 and Construction of New Enterprises and Services Tower 3 in SEEPZ SEZ
tenders.tendering_authority: Santacruz Electronics Export Processing Zone Special Economic Zone Mumbai
tenders.scope_summary: The tender is for Project Management Consultancy (PMC) for the demolition of Standard Design Factory 1 and the construction of a new Enterprises and Services Tower 3 in SEEPZ SEZ, Mumbai. This includes preparing 3D BIM models (LOD 300/350) for all disciplines as per ISO 19650 standards for design coordination, clash detection, and quantity estimation.
key_points: PMC for demolition and new construction in SEEPZ SEZ.
Preparation of 3D BIM models (LOD 300/350) for all disciplines.
BIM models to support design coordination, clash detection, and quantity estimation.
Architectural design aligned with Master Plan under Package 1.
